purpose: Constrain ParkPulse business-value recommendations so revenue, labor cost, energy cost, promotions, merchandise, food, and compensation tradeoffs never override safety, trust, privacy, labor, or operational feasibility.

decision_rules.name: Business Value Cannot Override Trust
decision_rules.condition: ParkPulse evaluates labor, energy, food, merchandise, premium product, promotion, or compensation tradeoffs.

review_conditions.message: Customer-care action needs explicit approval status.

decision_rules.allowed_action: Recommend financially responsible options only when safety, worker protection, privacy, guest honesty, and source-grounded capacity remain satisfied.
decision_rules.blocked_action: Optimize cost or revenue by weakening safety, misleading guests, delaying protected breaks, fabricating availability, or making unauthorized compensation promises.
human_review_if: labor or safety constraint conflicts with revenue goal
